# 1.2.128 - the table's notes of 22.11.2026: a second GM on a par with the first, Hide, every action's result in the middle, the tokens' names, and the session-0 fixes to the trial, the voice, the mask, the cards and the Truth Bullets

Three stages ship in one release: E127, E128 and E129 (tools/stages.json; 1.2.127 was never released). E127 carries the
owner's requests from the table of 22.11.2026, played on 1.2.126; E128 a second full GM on a par with the primary
(OWNER-128-SECOND-GM); E129 the owner's notes from that table, session 0, given on 23.11.2026 (the S0-... items). The
owner, 23.11.2026: "Wypusc to wszystko w 1.2.128. Niech 1.2.128 poczeka na wnioski z sesji 0". Built by ten lines -
CORE, UI, TRIAL, COMM, MURDER, INVEST, MAP, DESP, STG and TEXT - and the assembly's own commits. **E39, E40, E43, E53,
E58 and E83 are not shipped**, planned 1.2.129. E26 stays 1.3.0. From v1.2.126 (the tag) to 7a5f479b, the assembly's
last commit before this release commit: 163 commits, 47 of them merges, each a line's branch into the assembly or the
assembly into a line's branch; three more commits apply a line's tree without its screenshots (`git rev-list --count`,
`--merges --count` and `--first-parent`).

In plain words. Everything below is read off the code, the commits and the headless harness; none of it has run on a
real Foundry or at a table (## Checked).

**Every action's result card takes the middle** (E127, line UI; the owner: "nie wszystkie akcje wyswietlaja
powiadomienie na srodku (np facilities)", OWNER-127-CENTRE).
- An inventory of every road that ends in a result card the acting player waits on (docs/dev/owner127/INVENTORY.md):
  46 rows; 21 took the middle in 1.2.126, all 46 do now. The 25 new ones include Facilities, Rest, Observe's and
  Analyze's verdicts, Find Stash, a passage, Steal's, Plant's and Frisk's verdicts, an item used, Echoes, the crisis
  actions, the opening, a killer's own Stage 4 and Stage Six.
- Only the ask for the middle is added (notice-centre.mjs `withCentre`, the name `actionResult`). As before, a player's
  card never takes the middle on another player's screen.
- Kept in the corner on purpose, with the reason for each in the inventory's section 2: refusals, receipts, the GMs'
  records, the time of day, the messenger, a Hope Call's card, and a Tail's or a Keep Watch's later steps.
- What happens to a player who did not act takes the middle of that player's screen alone (the coordinator's default;
  the owner's screenshots show no such card): a Tail noticed, a Steal or a Plant felt, an unseen Frisk felt, and an open
  Frisk's outcome (the name `doneToYou`, on the primary GM's cards to the target).

**A result card says what its roll did** (E129 S0-CARDS, line DESP; the owner: "niech one rezultatu akcji jasno mowia
graczowi, co jest skutkiem jego wyniku i dzialan, w tym krytyka").
- Under a roll's dice the card lists what the roll fell into: with Hope, 1 Hope; a critical, 2 Hope and, unlike plain
  Daggerheart, no Sanity; with Despair, no Hope and its point to the pool of the Monokuma who watches the student; a
  supporting roll (a cover, staying unseen, a concealment), no Hope, its Despair still counted (action-report.mjs
  `rollEffectLines`; docs/dev/owner129/desp/CARDS.md, row by row). No line names a resource's new value.
- An opening's and a crisis action's card says it to the roller's own users alone. A price given back after the dice is
  said on a card of its own, in the corner.

**Hope from the action's main roll only** (E129 S0-REFUND, line DESP; the owner: "niektore akcje zwracaja hope i akcje
przy rzucie mimo ze nie powinny").
- A supporting roll - a cover or a concealment - earns no Hope on the GM's draw (roll-draw.mjs `throwDrawn`); its
  critical keeps its own rule (Tamper's concealment gives back 1 Sanity). In 1.2.126 an action with two rolls could earn
  Hope twice. The owner's answer: "Z glownego".
- As before, by the owner's answers of 23.11.2026: a price refused or not carried out after the dice comes back ("c"),
  and a critical Tamper keeps its 2 Hope and gives back what paid ("Zostawiamy jak jest"). Each rule is one key of
  config.mjs `ROLL_REFUNDS`; the inventory of the 19 roads is docs/dev/owner129/desp/REFUNDS.md.

**A second full GM on a par with the primary** (E128, line CORE; the owner at the table: "Drugi GM nie moze akceptowac
akcji i generalnie ma ograniczone dzialanie - powinien byc na rowni z pierwszym gmem", and on 23.11.2026 "kazdy gm ma
byc rowny").
- An inventory of what a second GM can press (docs/dev/owner128/SECOND-GM.md, 129 controls read), then the fixes. Each
  of these is carried out on the primary GM's browser, by the same code as the primary's own press, through a GM-only
  bridge row: Observe's "say what it is", from **Write it here** on the second GM's whisper (the first answer of the
  two is the find's); a second GM's own opening roll, so the killer's "?" mask and the witnesses are put up; announcing
  a body and the end of the chapter, whose windows now open on the second GM's browser; **Finish the verdict** on a
  verdict the primary runs; and **Fix voice**.
- A Call's yes or a Dynamic answer from a second GM after the player stopped waiting settles the card as on the primary
  ("The player was no longer waiting."), where it stayed open with live buttons.
- Season setup's Reset the season on a second GM says the reset is the primary's and keeps the window with what was
  typed; it closed unsaved before.
- The opening's request card and its "the GM is choosing" line are posted once, by the primary, however many GMs ask.
  The Passages tab's "not yet sent to" line reads the same on every full GM (the primary sends the others what each copy
  names).
- An Assistant GM's limits are unchanged.

**Hide, a new Infiltrate row** (E129 S0-HIDE, line STG; the owner: "Wazne - ukryj sie ma dzialac do konca pory dnia").
- A Shadow roll at 15, one action, not in a Class Trial: a hit or a critical hides the student. Other players, a
  Spectator and the killers' side stop drawing their token, its frame, bars and name; the hider sees it at 0.4, a GM at
  0.5. Their microphone is held while they still hear the room; other players' voice lists, pickers and Listen (a GM's
  too) leave them out (hide.mjs, a new file; visibility.mjs `dressHiding`).
- It ends with the time of day it began in (an Eclipse's start or end and a Rewind included), at **Reveal yourself** on
  the hider's voice tile, a GM's reveal (the GM's voice list, or `game.drpg.unhide(actor)`), the chapter's end, the
  season's reset or the student's death. An end by the time of day, a GM, the chapter or a Reroll is told on the
  hider's notice tile, where their other notices appear (the owner: "notice o ujawnieniu niech bedzie w lewym dolnym rogu
  jak reszta powiadomien"); Reveal yourself and a death tell nothing.
- While hidden, an action's Shadow roll for staying unseen is not thrown and counts as passed, with no Hope: Palm's, an
  unseen Frisk's, Tail Someone's, Pick the Lock's, a Take in front of others, and the cover of a Sabotage, an indirect
  murder's work or a clean-up. The card says so. A Reroll replays the hide.
- A new known leak, low: a player's console can resolve the flagged token to the hidden student (## Known gaps).

**The tokens' names** (E129 S0-HOVERNAME, line MAP; the owner: "Najechanie na token myszka przez chwile dluzej niech
pokazuje nazwe (imie postaci, "?" Mordercy, nazwe projektu, nazwe remnanta)").
- A new client setting, **Token names as captions** (on by default, in the gear's window), draws each token's name under
  it, moving with it. Off, the name shows when the pointer has rested on a token for 600 ms (config.mjs `HOVER_NAME`).
- The name is as this browser may know it (hover-name.mjs `hoverName`): "?" for a masked killer to everyone but their
  owners and the GMs; a Remnant's name only from the player's own Truth Bullet of it, else the neutral word; a secret
  project's name only where it is seen; none for a body, which its tile already names, and none for a token this browser
  does not draw. No name where Foundry's own nameplate already shows it.
- Both follow the module's interface scale; the glass's caption is sized to Legacy's x-height (config.mjs
  `CAPTION_FACE`).

**A Remnant whole on the GM's map** (E129 S0-REMALPHA, line MAP; the owner: "niektore remnanty sa polprzezroczyste").
- Each browser draws a Remnant at one alpha (config.mjs `REMNANT_ALPHA`): a player 0.5 as before, a GM 1 for a trace the
  players see and 0.6 for a hidden one. New traces are created at 1; older ones need no migration, the drawing is set at
  every refresh.

**A Truth Bullet's holder sees its Remnant** (E129 S0-BULLETSEES, line INVEST; the owner: "zawsze posiadanie truth bullet
= widoczny token remnanta, w tym po przekazaniu go na przyklad").
- A trace a GM hid by hand is drawn for a holder of its bullet (config.mjs `HOLDER_SEES_HIDDEN`, on; the owner: holding
  wins). A player made an owner of a student mid-session is sent the keys of its bullets at once, not at a reload
  (truth-bullets.mjs `tellNewOwners`).

**A Share, a Reshape and the Realization** (E129 S0-ANSHARE, S0-TAMPERDESC, S0-REALIZE, line INVEST).
- A Share of a Truth Bullet that holds an Analyze result asks whether the result goes too (**Share it with my Analyze
  result**, ticked as it opens; config.mjs `SHARE_WITH_ANALYSIS`); unticked, the copy reads as never analyzed, as
  Present's does. A bullet with no reading asks nothing.
- A shared copy carries the giver's words, also after a reshape (the owner: "Slowa dajacego"). No behaviour changed;
  the Share's note and both handbooks now say it.
- The Realization asks **Key Remnants only** (the default, as before; config.mjs `REALIZE_SCOPE`) or **Every planned
  Remnant and Truth Bullet**: the second also places each planned incident Remnant and Final Truth with no trace in its
  room and gives each planned Truth Bullet not yet given; Undo takes back what nobody found and the bullets it gave.

**The killer's mask and the victim** (E129 S0-MASKLEFT, S0-VICTIM, line MURDER; the owner: "Zawsze zdejmujemy maske na
koniec incydentu morderstwa (po sprzataniu)", and when the killer leaves the room).
- The mask now also ends at every close of its murder's incident, whoever died, and when one of the killer's tokens
  lands in another room or scene; the killer's player is told which. A close by a second GM ends it on the primary. A
  season reset's abandon ends it without a card. Until now it ended at a reveal, a new time of day, a lost race at the
  opening or the season's reset.
- A dead student's player who owns that student's watcher watches as a Spectator at once, walking the watcher's token
  (spectator.mjs `DEAD_VIEW`; the owner: "ofiara po smierci od razu powinna stawac sie spectatorem"). The Students
  window's Spectator role on a dead student makes that watcher and leaves the body where it fell; until now it turned
  the body's own token into the Spectator's (the owner: "Po dostaniu spectatora przez gm panel zabralo token ciala").

**The dead's marks** (E129 S0-DEADMARK items 1 and 2, line CORE; the owner: "czaszka powinna byc od smierci, nie od
ogloszenia").
- The skull stands on a corpse's token from the death, a death the GMs keep included, not from the announcement, on
  every browser (body-tile.mjs `markCorpse`); a revive and the season reset take it off.
- A kept death stamps the character sheets already open for it, on the GMs' and the dead student's player's browsers,
  without a reopen (sheet.mjs `redrawDeathMarks`; the owner: "gracze nie widzieli "dead" na portrecie ciala w karcie
  postaci").

**A Spectator** (E127; the owner: "Spectatorzy. Ich ramka kwadratowa renderowana przez modul niech tez ma zmniejszone
opacity" and "Spectatorzy nie widza obramowania pokoju (i dziur w scianach/drzwi) tak jak reszta graczy").
- On a GM's browser the square frame under a Spectator's token fades to the token's own alpha (config.mjs
  `SPECTATOR_ALPHA`, 0.3; own-ring.mjs `dressFrame`), line UI.
- A Spectator sees the outline of the room their own token stands in, its gaps and doors with it, in a room the class
  has already discovered; their walk still discovers nothing (fog.mjs `spectatorLeadRoom`), line CORE.

**A picture whose name has parentheses is drawn** (E127, line UI, OWNER-127-PORTRAIT-PARENS: the second GM's portrait
on the voice tile was a Forge file named `..._(Swimsuit)_Preview.webp`).
- `safeRoomImage` and `safePortrait` (vault-store.mjs) encode `(` as `%28` and `)` as `%29` instead of refusing the
  path; a path already written so is kept; every other refusal stands.

**The voice** (E129 S0-GMMUTE, S0-HIDEMUTE, S0-VOICE, line COMM).
- **Your own microphone follows its button** (the owner, a GM, muted with the voice tile and was still heard): this
  browser mutes its own LiveKit track while the button is muted, held or blocked by a GM, and opens it, in the always-on
  mode, only when nothing holds it (voice-client.mjs `followHold`, config.mjs `OWN_TRACK_FOLLOWS_HOLD`, on). Before,
  only Foundry's permission was written, and avclient-livekit 0.6.8 moves the track only through its own toggle. Only
  that client's 0.6 names are touched; another version is logged once and left alone.
- **A token the GM hides holds its player's microphone** outside the Class Trial, said on the button (voice.mjs
  `HIDDEN_TOKEN_MUTES`, on; the owner: "niech chowanie tokenu automatycznie wycisza na livekit (i pokazuje rowniez te
  zmiane na przycisku mikrofonu)"). Showing it gives back only what the hide held; a dead student's hidden body holds
  nobody's microphone.
- **Whom your page does not hear** (the owner: "osoba a nie slyszy osoby b slyszac reszte"): every 10 seconds each page
  checks the people of its voice room with an open microphone; one it does not hear reads why in **Who you hear**, with
  the advice to reload (F5), and one you muted reads **Muted by you**. A paused sound is played and an unreceived
  microphone received, once per person and reason; the GMs are told when the list changes, and the voice plan lists "Who
  does not hear whom" (voice-tile.mjs `hearingGaps`, `repairHearing`).

**The messenger** (E129 S0-MSGSORT, S0-MSGSIZE, line COMM).
- The GM's list puts the players with a message first, the newest last message first, the rest after by name (the owner:
  "niech osoby od ktorych mamy wiadomosc wyswietlaja sie najwyzej (sortowanie po czasie)").
- Both windows are larger: the GM's 1370 x 950, a player's 760 x 730, cut to 90% of the screen, at every opening (the
  owner: "powiekszmy cale okno messenger znacznie").

**The GM panel** (E129 S0-GMLIST, S0-WHITE, line UI).
- The panel's standing block opens on a roster again, first after the case warning: each student's actions left, their
  Free Move or, in an Eclipse, the crossings left (or "Any room"), a dimmed row for a student with nothing left
  (gm-panel.mjs `rosterTableHtml`; the owner: "przywrocmy liste akcji i ruchow graczy do glownej zakladki gm panel na
  gorze"). It folded into one line in 1.2.105.
- A board whose drawing context is lost is recorded in that browser's failure log and told to the GMs once, until it
  comes back: "<name>'s browser lost its drawing context (<scene>)." (context-loss.mjs, a new file). It prevents nothing;
  whether the context comes back stays Foundry's.

**The Class Trial** (E129, line TRIAL).
- An Objection's own time is 30 seconds (60 until now); in the Closing Argument it keeps 60 (S0-OBJ). The objector may
  end their seconds early from *Finish your turn now?* (S0-SKIP).
- In Testimony and a Panic Round a speaker whose player drops is passed only if they are not back within 15 seconds; a
  connected player takes part with the student linked to them as their character; with more than 5 seconds left, Done and
  Pass ask *End your turn now?* first (S0-CUT).
- A world switch, **Class Trial: no forced muting** (off by default, in the Game settings' Voice section): when on, the
  trial turns no microphone off, neither the floor's nor the dead's (S0-NOMUTE).
- Palm is open in the trial for its Frisk alone (the owner: "z palm w trialu ma byc dostepne tylko przeszukanie -
  ukradkiem, consensual lub silowe"): the unseen Frisk, the asked one and the force after a refusal or no answer, the
  hall counting as one room, paid an action, else 1 Hope, else 1 Sanity, the card naming which; Steal and Plant wait
  until the trial is over. An ask still open when the trial begins or ends is interrupted and its price given back
  (S0-PALM; allowed-now.mjs `TRIAL_OPEN_PERSON`, palm.mjs `payPalm`, `refundPalm`).
- The ballot lists each Monokuma by its own name and counts them apart; a vote on any of them reads as a vote on
  Monokuma always did. A world with no Monokuma character offers none (S0-VOTEKUMA).
- The zone modes draw their two zones as the map draws rooms, each named at its middle by its answer in large letters
  for the whole mode; the event tile and the cards name the answers, not "Zone A" and "Zone B" (S0-ZONESTYLE). The GM's
  setup keeps the letters.

**Two paces of a session** (E129 S0-SESSIONLEN, line TEXT; the owner: "Sesja 15min na pore dnia mialaby wtedy 2 dni a nie
1").
- The GM handbook, section 4: the Full pace, one game day in a session at the table, about 30 minutes a time of day; the
  Quick pace, two game days, about 15 minutes. Both come to about 2 hours 30 minutes, the Eclipses on top. Nothing is
  enforced and no rule changed: the HUD's marks stay at 15 and 30 minutes, and the clock counts each game day as a
  session, so at the Quick pace what comes once per session (the Long Rest) comes twice in one session at the table.

## Before installing

- **No migration clause is added** (scripts/migrate.mjs has no change in the range). Traces created before this release
  keep their document alpha of 0.5; every browser draws them at `REMNANT_ALPHA` all the same.
- **Two settings are registered**: **Token names as captions** (`tokenCaptions`, a client setting, on by default, in the
  gear's window) and **Class Trial: no forced muting** (`trialVoicesFree`, a world setting, off by default, in the Game
  settings' Voice section). **One GM store is added**: `hides` (settings.mjs `gmHides`, the hidden students; synced and
  backed up). Tokens gain the module's flags `hiding`, `hideEnd` and `corpse`.
- **Language**: lang/en.json goes from 6539 to 6639 keys: 100 added (among them `DRPG.Hide.*`, `DRPG.Result.*`,
  `DRPG.Voice.hearing.*`, `DRPG.CaseRealize.*`, `DRPG.Trial.finish.*`, `DRPG.Observe.describe*`, eight
  `DRPG.Bridge.what.*` and the two settings' names and hints), none removed, 35 changed (27 of them the zone modes'
  texts without "Zone A" and "Zone B", 3 the mask's end and a kept death's box read against the code). lang/pl.json goes
  from 7628 to 7734: the same 100 and the `.few` and `.many` of `DRPG.Result.hope`, `.critical` and `.coverCritical`;
  37 changed. Counted on the flattened files, v1.2.126 against 7a5f479b.
- No glyph added (icons/ and tools/glyphs.json have no change). **One console name is added**: `game.drpg.unhide(actor)`,
  a GM's reveal of a hidden student (tools/api-surface.json).
- **Daggerheart**: `verified` stays 2.12.9. **Foundry**: module.json's compatibility has no change (minimum 14.364,
  verified 14.365); the owner's sandbox runs 14.370, which module.json does not name.

## Known gaps

- **Not shipped**: E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 (tools/stages.json, planned 1.2.129). E26 stays 1.3.0.
- **A second GM**: still left as found (SECOND-GM.md): passing the crisis turn before that GM's copy of the cast has
  arrived is refused for that moment; an Observe pick a second GM's list offers may be answered "not there" by the
  primary; a refund or a Sanity charge ruled there reads the sheet, not the primary's marks; a Monocub's Ask for Hope
  spends the pressing GM's own pool; the Timeline's stream holds only the notices that browser was shown.
- **Hide**: a player's browser console can resolve a hiding token to its student and read why a hide ended (the new
  known leak, foundry-hiding-token-actor, low: Foundry sends every token's flags to every client).
- **The corpse's mark**: from the death, a console reads on the token that the student is dead before anybody
  announced it, and a student alone in the room sees a body (world-secrets.mjs, named there as the mark's purpose).
- **The cards**: "you earn 1 Hope" is said when Hope is already at its maximum. A Sabotage seen by another player is
  not centred on that player's screen.
- **The voice**: `followHold` handles only avclient-livekit 0.6. Whether it cures the GM heard while muted at a real
  table is not measured; nor is the hearing check against a real LiveKit room.
- **What the owner's table saw and this release does not find**: a thin horizontal line on one player's screen - no
  commit in the range names it; a white screen on another's is now recorded and told to the GMs (S0-WHITE), its cause
  not found.
- How a Foundry server and The Forge decode `%28` and `%29` is not measured. The captions are drawn in the harness on a
  stand-in, not in PIXI.
- **The local gate**: only its press part ran (## Checked); its eight parts that need a Foundry v14 sandbox did not, so its verdict
  is incomplete. Nothing in this release has run on a real Foundry or at a table: audit/AUDIT-1.2.42.md 9.2 holds the
  live checks.
- **Hide's flow** (scripts/tests-flows.mjs) stays partial: the Shadow roll's draw from a player's page is not driven
  headless. Carried to E39.
- **Carried, not closed**: the 13 rows of audit/harness/known-leaks.json as at 1.2.126, and the new one: 14 rows.
